records.title: FeEcho4D fetal echo annotations and fitted meshes
records.version_note: BR-025 source audit checked on 2026-09-16, native Zenodo record 21322299, Patient001: 30 frames and 37 radial planes. Partial archive retrieval verified extracted member CRCs and SHA-256; full archive MD5 was not verified.
records.terms_note: On 2026-09-16 the project stated non-commercial research use; precise downstream redistribution permission remained unresolved. No current permission or access refresh is implied.
records.reference_note: Real fetal STIC with annotated/propagated LV cavity and myocardium contours and fitted meshes. Sparse radial embedding zeros are unobserved, not annotated background. Physical mesh transform, cavity partition and ED/ES index base remained unaudited; whole mesh volume is not an EF oracle.
records.access_note: Native Patient001 was retained locally for author calibration. The source receipt separately records gated alternatives that were not requested; this record does not grant or request their access.

records.title: Multimodality STRAUS simulated ultrasound and material motion
records.version_note: BR-029 integrity review dated 2026-09-16 verifies retained patient01_healthy image/mesh and patient04_lbbb mesh manifests. BR-035 reuses the audited 30-frame healthy simulation; exact task transformations remain experiment-specific.
records.terms_note: Public Girder access was recorded in the September 2026 source review, but public downloading did not establish redistribution permission. Source assets were kept local; no current license determination is added.
records.reference_note: Simulator meshes have persistent topology and material identities, unlike clinical image-derived contours. Directional strain excludes elements without valid source directions. Synthetic truth is not measured patient strain; matching masks alone does not uniquely determine material motion.
records.access_note: Healthy ultrasound and meshes and the separate LBBB mesh sequence were retained and hash-verified in BR-029. The BR-025 inventory-only note predates those acquisitions and remains historical.

records.title: EchoSlicer real volunteer 3D echo
records.version_note: BR-032 source review on 2026-09-16 inspected code commit 78f7085104492d5229b1bb96b7748ad9d950e53d and the release dated 2025-11-19. The selected dataset/A_0.dcm SHA-256 is retained in source notes; 18 native phases were decoded.
records.terms_note: Historical review established public downloading, not redistribution permission. Original scan and case outputs stay local. No current license or access check was performed.
records.reference_note: Recorded volunteer images have no paired reference reconstruction or clinical EF oracle in this case. Supplied calibrated planes are geometric slices, not expert-certified standard views; a fitted animation is not anatomical accuracy evidence.
records.access_note: Only the selected archive member was retrieved through byte ranges for BR-032. Source DICOM and original metadata stayed outside the solver package; public pretraining exposure remains unknown.

records.title: EchoXFlow clinical echo and LV endocardial surfaces
records.version_note: BR-034 September 2026 review inspected source code commit b782e0a4e3dbaadf3c88fa572710bf4254d86143 and catalog SHA-256 2b0e80f83f8743f5babde82a3d8ded8ec4d607a1889a1b8b8cd204342116f83d. Exact selected recordings and native/reconstruction hashes remain in BR-034/035 receipts.
records.terms_note: The retained source review records CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Clinical assets remain local; confirm the selected release and all conditions before reuse or redistribution. No current permission refresh is implied.
records.reference_note: Clinical B-mode volumes have operator-created or adjusted LV endocardial surfaces. These are geometric/function references with observer/software uncertainty, not independent material trajectories or etiologic diagnosis. BR-034 supplies the initial surface; BR-035 supplies all-phase cavity masks that already encode EF.
records.access_note: BR-032 inspected the card without acquiring examinations; subsequent BR-034 acquired selected archives and BR-035 reused a clinical sequence. Whole TAR hashes matched publisher LFS hashes, but the publisher array-hash serialization was not reproduced.
